title: Zscaler AI Guard Licensing and Fair Use

blocks.text: Zscaler AI Guard is a Software as a Service (SaaS) product that is licensed based on a platform subscription fee and the number of tokens purchased for the subscription term in an order.

AI Guard uses transformers that tokenize prompts and responses. A token is the standard non-divisible metric of consumption used by Generative AI models. A token is generally considered to be four characters, using UTF-8 code points, excluding white space. AI Guard uses the total number of tokens in prompts and responses to calculate license consumption.

Ensure that you order the correct number of tokens for your application requirement. If you require additional tokens, contact Zscaler Sales or your Channel Partner. Zscaler periodically reviews the number of tokens consumed to ensure license compliance.
The usage of Zscaler AI Guard is expected to be in accordance with the Acceptable Use Policy.
